subject: Engineering Technical Officer Engineering Design application, Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application: Engineering Technical Officer Engineering Design
paragraphs: I am applying for the Engineering Technical Officer Engineering Design role with the City of South Perth, listed on SEEK and closing on 16 October 2026. The role supports the Civil Design Coordinator on roads, drainage, parking and active transport design.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt and as field engineer at Grand Travaux, including inspections, crew coordination, materials tracking and progress reports. My AutoCAD and Civil 3D experience to date is academic rather than commercial production drafting.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Perth for this role and I am willing to obtain a National Police Clearance.
I have attached my resume. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
